title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

The shock to BND from “The Fed's rate is 5.00% or higher after April: a rise at every meeting, or a half-point step”

BND fell 1.7% over the window in which one extra rise was priced, more than its link to long yields gives, because 2- to 10-year yields carry the policy path. Roughly double that for two or more extra rises.
